variants.name: 500 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Highly varied fibre snack with vegetables
  • A delicious natural mixture based on high-fibre chunks, beetroot, chicory and carob
  • Prevents boredom and brings variation to the daily menu
  • Ideal snack for rabbits, guinea pigs, chinchillas and degus
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: derivatives of vegetable origin (timothy, grasses and herbs 14%), vegetables (peas 7.5%, chicory 5%, beetroot 4%), fruit (carob 9%), vegetable protein extracts, seeds, minerals, FOS, MOS, algae, yucca.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 15.6%, crude fat 3.5%, crude fibre 15%, crude ash 8.2%, calcium 1%, phosphorus 0.6%.
variants.feeding_instructions: A complementary treat alongside the daily Nature basic feed. Use in moderation. For a complete feeding plan, combine with Nature feed and Timothy Hay. Not for food-producing animals.
